22. // GCPLogEntry that will be written to the pubsub topic according to the following spec.
23. // https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry
24. type GCPLogEntry struct {
25. 	// why was this here?? nolint:revive
26. 	LogName  string `json:"logName"`
27. 	Resource struct {
28. 		Type   string            `json:"type"`
29. 		Labels map[string]string `json:"labels"`
30. 	} `json:"resource"`
31. 	Timestamp string `json:"timestamp"`
32. 
33. 	// The time the log entry was received by Logging.
34. 	// Its important that `Timestamp` is optional in GCE log entry.
35. 	ReceiveTimestamp string `json:"receiveTimestamp"`
36. 
37. 	// Optional. The severity of the log entry. The default value is DEFAULT.
38. 	// DEFAULT, DEBUG, INFO, NOTICE, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL, ALERT, EMERGENCY
39. 	// https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry#LogSeverity
40. 	Severity string `json:"severity"`
41. 
42. 	// Optional. A map of key, value pairs that provides additional information about the log entry.
43. 	// The labels can be user-defined or system-defined.
44. 	Labels map[string]string `json:"labels"`
45. 
46. 	TextPayload string `json:"textPayload"`
47. 
48. 	// NOTE(kavi): There are other fields on GCPLogEntry. but we need only need
49. 	// above fields for now anyway we will be sending the entire entry to Loki.
50. }
51. 
52. func parseGCPLogsEntry(data []byte, other model.LabelSet, otherInternal labels.Labels, useIncomingTimestamp bool, useFullLine bool, relabelConfig []*relabel.Config) (loki.Entry, error) {
53. 	var ge GCPLogEntry
54. 
55. 	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &ge); err != nil {
56. 		return loki.Entry{}, err
57. 	}
58. 
59. 	// Adding mandatory labels for gcplog
60. 	lbs := labels.NewBuilder(otherInternal)
61. 	lbs.Set("__gcp_logname", ge.LogName)
62. 	lbs.Set("__gcp_resource_type", ge.Resource.Type)
63. 	lbs.Set("__gcp_severity", ge.Severity)
64. 
65. 	// resource labels from gcp log entry. Add it as internal labels
66. 	for k, v := range ge.Resource.Labels {
67. 		lbs.Set("__gcp_resource_labels_"+convertToLokiCompatibleLabel(k), v)
68. 	}
69. 
70. 	// labels from gcp log entry. Add it as internal labels
71. 	for k, v := range ge.Labels {
72. 		lbs.Set("__gcp_labels_"+convertToLokiCompatibleLabel(k), v)
73. 	}
74. 
75. 	var processed labels.Labels
76. 
77. 	// apply relabeling
78. 	if len(relabelConfig) > 0 {
79. 		processed, _ = relabel.Process(lbs.Labels(), relabelConfig...)
80. 	} else {
81. 		processed = lbs.Labels()
82. 	}
83. 
84. 	// final labelset that will be sent to loki
85. 	labels := make(model.LabelSet)
86. 	for _, lbl := range processed {
87. 		// ignore internal labels
88. 		if strings.HasPrefix(lbl.Name, "__") {
89. 			continue
90. 		}
91. 		// ignore invalid labels
92. 		// TODO: add support for different validation schemes.
93. 		//nolint:staticcheck
94. 		if !model.LabelName(lbl.Name).IsValid() || !model.LabelValue(lbl.Value).IsValid() {
95. 			continue
96. 		}
97. 		labels[model.LabelName(lbl.Name)] = model.LabelValue(lbl.Value)
98. 	}
99. 
100. 	// add labels coming from scrapeconfig
101. 	labels = labels.Merge(other)
102. 
103. 	ts := time.Now()
104. 	line := string(data)
105. 
106. 	if useIncomingTimestamp {
107. 		tt := ge.Timestamp
108. 		if tt == "" {
109. 			tt = ge.ReceiveTimestamp
110. 		}
111. 		var err error
112. 		ts, err = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, tt)
113. 		if err != nil {
114. 			return loki.Entry{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid timestamp format: %w", err)
115. 		}
116. 
117. 		if ts.IsZero() {
118. 			return loki.Entry{}, fmt.Errorf("no timestamp found in the log entry")
119. 		}
120. 	}
121. 
122. 	// Send only `ge.textPayload` as log line if its present and user don't explicitly ask for the whole log.
123. 	if !useFullLine && strings.TrimSpace(ge.TextPayload) != "" {
124. 		line = ge.TextPayload
125. 	}
126. 
127. 	return loki.Entry{
128. 		Labels: labels,
129. 		Entry: logproto.Entry{
130. 			Timestamp: ts,
131. 			Line:      line,
132. 		},
133. 	}, nil
134. }

35. 	ReceiveTimestamp string `json:"receiveTimestamp"`
36. 
37. 	// Optional. The severity of the log entry. The default value is DEFAULT.
38. 	// DEFAULT, DEBUG, INFO, NOTICE, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL, ALERT, EMERGENCY
39. 	// https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/reference/v2/rest/v2/LogEntry#LogSeverity
40. 	Severity string `json:"severity"`

45.

52. func parseGCPLogsEntry(data []byte, other model.LabelSet, otherInternal labels.Labels, useIncomingTimestamp bool, useFullLine bool, relabelConfig []*relabel.Config) (loki.Entry, error) {
53. 	var ge GCPLogEntry
54. 
55. 	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &ge); err != nil {
56. 		return loki.Entry{}, err
57. 	}
58. 
59. 	// Adding mandatory labels for gcplog
60. 	lbs := labels.NewBuilder(otherInternal)
61. 	lbs.Set("__gcp_logname", ge.LogName)
62. 	lbs.Set("__gcp_resource_type", ge.Resource.Type)
63. 	lbs.Set("__gcp_severity", ge.Severity)
64. 
65. 	// resource labels from gcp log entry. Add it as internal labels
66. 	for k, v := range ge.Resource.Labels {
67. 		lbs.Set("__gcp_resource_labels_"+convertToLokiCompatibleLabel(k), v)
68. 	}
69. 
70. 	// labels from gcp log entry. Add it as internal labels
71. 	for k, v := range ge.Labels {
72. 		lbs.Set("__gcp_labels_"+convertToLokiCompatibleLabel(k), v)
73. 	}
74. 
75. 	var processed labels.Labels
76. 
77. 	// apply relabeling
78. 	if len(relabelConfig) > 0 {
79. 		processed, _ = relabel.Process(lbs.Labels(), relabelConfig...)
80. 	} else {
81. 		processed = lbs.Labels()
82. 	}
83. 
84. 	// final labelset that will be sent to loki
85. 	labels := make(model.LabelSet)
86. 	for _, lbl := range processed {
87. 		// ignore internal labels
88. 		if strings.HasPrefix(lbl.Name, "__") {
89. 			continue
90. 		}
91. 		// ignore invalid labels
92. 		// TODO: add support for different validation schemes.
93. 		//nolint:staticcheck
94. 		if !model.LabelName(lbl.Name).IsValid() || !model.LabelValue(lbl.Value).IsValid() {
95. 			continue
96. 		}
97. 		labels[model.LabelName(lbl.Name)] = model.LabelValue(lbl.Value)
98. 	}
99. 
100. 	// add labels coming from scrapeconfig
101. 	labels = labels.Merge(other)
102. 
103. 	ts := time.Now()
104. 	line := string(data)
105. 
106. 	if useIncomingTimestamp {
107. 		tt := ge.Timestamp
108. 		if tt == "" {
109. 			tt = ge.ReceiveTimestamp
110. 		}
111. 		var err error
112. 		ts, err = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, tt)
113. 		if err != nil {
114. 			return loki.Entry{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid timestamp format: %w", err)
115. 		}
116. 
117. 		if ts.IsZero() {
118. 			return loki.Entry{}, fmt.Errorf("no timestamp found in the log entry")
119. 		}
120. 	}
121. 
122. 	// Send only `ge.textPayload` as log line if its present and user don't explicitly ask for the whole log.
123. 	if !useFullLine && strings.TrimSpace(ge.TextPayload) != "" {
124. 		line = ge.TextPayload
125. 	}
126. 
127. 	return loki.Entry{
128. 		Labels: labels,
129. 		Entry: logproto.Entry{
130. 			Timestamp: ts,
131. 			Line:      line,
132. 		},
133. 	}, nil
134. }

```go
err := sub.Receive(ctx, func(ctx context.Context, msg *pubsub.Message) {
    // ...do something
    msg.Ack() // or msg.Nack()
})

// The new way in v1.50.0+
err := sub.Receive(ctx, func(ctx context.Context, msg *pubsub.Message) {
    // ...do something
    msg.Deliver(pubsub.Ack) // Instead of msg.Ack()
    // or
    msg.Deliver(pubsub.Nack) // Instead of msg.Nack()
})
